newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy completes Lawton well.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy completes Lawton well.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp said Thursday it completed the Lawton 4 well.

Located in the Masters Creek portion of the Louisiana Trend, the well tested at a daily rate of 4,224 barrels of oil and 13.0 million cubic feet of natural gas on a 30/64 inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 6,200 pounds per square inch.
Chesapeake owns an 81 percent working interest in Lawton 4. It said the well should begin producing into permanent production facilities by early next week.
